```powershell
$target=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=5500"
if(-not $target -or $target.Name -ne 'media_transcode_realtime_video_cli.exe' -or $target.CommandLine -notlike '*composition-r263*'){throw 'CLI identity mismatch'}
Add-Type -TypeDefinition @'
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
public static class R263Console {
[DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError=true)] public static extern bool FreeConsole();
[DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError=true)] public static extern bool AttachConsole(uint id);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError=true)] public static extern bool SetConsoleCtrlHandler(IntPtr handler,bool add);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError=true)] public static extern uint GetConsoleProcessList(uint[] ids,uint count);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError=true)] public static extern bool GenerateConsoleCtrlEvent(uint kind,uint group);
}
'@
[R263Console]::FreeConsole() | Out-Null
if(-not [R263Console]::AttachConsole(5500)){throw 'AttachConsole failed'}
try {
[R263Console]::SetConsoleCtrlHandler([IntPtr]::Zero,$true) | Out-Null
$ids=[uint32[]]::new(16)
$count=[R263Console]::GetConsoleProcessList($ids,16)
if($count -ne 2 -or $ids[0..1] -notcontains 5500 -or $ids[0..1] -notcontains $PID){throw 'Unexpected shared console process'}
if(-not [R263Console]::GenerateConsoleCtrlEvent(0,0)){throw 'CtrlC failed'}
Write-Output 'CLI caller-stop requested'
} finally {[R263Console]::FreeConsole() | Out-Null}
```
